admission.justification: The digest planner and held passage map distinguish an unchanged exact-hash relocation from an authored semantic rebinding, preventing a moved or repeated passage from silently acquiring the wrong unit, evidence association or clause.

applicability: Digest-map source, evidence, place and clause passage bindings.
conditions: An association has an authored stable unit or place identity.
exclusions: Pointer-action wording has its separately defined matching policy, including an unambiguous residual sentence; this statement does not impose digest matching on pointers.
statement: An unchanged mapped passage is relocated by exact hash windows, while changed or ambiguous text requires an explicit named binding.
